Photo File Section, UNIT 3 varag'i. Bet raqami yo'q (varaq qirqib olinadi).

⚠ Bu — RASMLI XAT: Paula do'sti Vickyga yangi kvartirasi haqida yozadi. Matn ichida SO'Z O'RNIGA RASM qo'yilgan, yonida esa nuqtali bo'sh joy bor — o'quvchi rasmga qarab so'zni yozadi.

⚠ BIRINCHI JAVOB KITOBDA BERILGAN (namuna sifatida, qiyshiq harflar bilan): 'block of flats'.

Kitob mashq matnini bermagan — vazifa namunadan tushuniladi. Qolgan javoblar rasmlarni tanib olish asosida berildi.

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 3 - Look at the pictures and write the words. (The first one is done for you: block of flats)
exercises.instructionUz: 3-UNIT — Rasmlarga qarang va so'zlarni yozing. (Birinchisi namuna: block of flats)
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — RASMLI XAT.

  Paula do'sti Vickyga yangi kvartirasi
  haqida yozadi. Matn ichida SO'Z O'RNIGA
  RASM qo'yilgan.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  block of flats  (KITOBDA BERILGAN)
  2  bathroom
  3  fireplace
  4  window
  5  bed
  6  dressing table
  7  lamp
  8  bookcase
  9  pictures
 10  plants


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

──────────────────────────────────
  Dear Vicky,

  I am in my new flat, at last! It's on
  the seventh floor of a big BLOCK OF
  FLATS near the city centre. The flat is
  wonderful. It's got two bedrooms, a
  kitchen, a BATHROOM and a huge
  living-room with a FIREPLACE in it.

  My favourite room is my bedroom, because
  it's very pretty. It's got a blue carpet
  on the floor and a large WINDOW with a
  great view of the city.

  My comfortable BED is right next to the
  DRESSING TABLE. There is also a small
  table in the room with a telephone and a
  LAMP on it.

  I've got a big BOOKCASE, a large
  wardrobe, a TV and a CD player in my
  bedroom. I've also got some PICTURES on
  the walls. My bedroom has got a balcony,
  too. There are some PLANTS on it.

  Well, that's all for now. Come and see
  my new flat soon!

              Love,
              Paula
──────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  'Aziz Vicky,

   Nihoyat yangi kvartiramdaman! U shahar
   markazi yaqinidagi katta ko'p qavatli
   binoning yettinchi qavatida. Kvartira
   ajoyib. Unda ikkita yotoqxona, oshxona,
   hammom va kaminli katta mehmonxona bor.

   Sevimli xonam — yotoqxonam, chunki u
   juda chiroyli. Polida ko'k gilam va
   shaharga ajoyib manzara ochiladigan
   katta deraza bor.

   Qulay karavotim kiyinish stoli yonida.
   Xonada yana telefon va chiroq turgan
   kichik stol bor.

   Yotoqxonamda katta kitob javoni, katta
   kiyim shkafi, televizor va CD pleyer
   bor. Devorlarda rasmlar ham bor.
   Yotoqxonamning balkoni ham bor. Unda
   gullar turibdi.

   Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tez orada yangi
   kvartiramni ko'rgani keling!

              Mehr bilan,
              Paula'


⚠ NEGA BIRINChI JAVOB BERILGAN:

  Kitob 'block of flats' ni QIYShIQ
  harflar bilan yozib qo'ygan — bu
  NAMUNA.

  O'quvchi shundan vazifani tushunadi:
  rasmga qarab so'zni yozish kerak.


⚠ 2-JAVOB — 'BATHROOM', 'BATH' EMAS:

  Rasmda VANNA ko'rinadi, lekin gap
  XONALAR ro'yxati haqida:

     'two bedrooms, a kitchen, a ......
      and a huge living-room'

  Hammasi XONA — demak 'BATHROOM'
  (hammom), 'bath' (vanna) emas.


⚠ 4-JAVOB — 'WINDOW', 'CURTAINS' EMAS:

  Rasmda PARDALAR ko'rinadi, lekin gap:

     'a LARGE ...... with a great VIEW of
      the city'

  Manzara DERAZADAN ochiladi, pardadan
  emas. Yana 'a large' — BIRLIK, 'curtains'
  esa ko'plik.

  → WINDOW


⚠ 9 va 10-JAVOBLAR KO'PLIKDA:

     'some PICTURES'  (some + ko'plik)
     'some PLANTS'

  ⚠ 'some' dan keyin sanaladigan ot
  KO'PLIKDA bo'ladi.


⚠ 'IT'S GOT' va 'THERE IS' FARQI:

  'The flat's GOT two bedrooms.'
     → EGALIK (kvartiraning nimasi bor)

  'THERE IS a small table in the room.'
     → MAVJUDLIK (xonada nima bor)

  Xatda ikkalasi ham ishlatilgan.


⚠ BRITANIYA QAVAT SANOG'I:

  'on the SEVENTH FLOOR'

  Britaniyada:
     ground floor = yerdagi qavat
     first floor  = undan YUQORIDAGI
     seventh floor = yerdan 8-qavat!

  Amerikada:
     first floor = yerdagi qavat


DO'STONA XAT QOLIPI:

  MUROJAAT — 'Dear Vicky,' (VERGUL bilan)
  YAKUN — 'Well, that's all for now.'
  TAKLIF — 'Come and see my new flat soon!'
  IMZO — 'Love, Paula'

  ⚠ Workbook 85-betdagi Maykalning xati
  bilan bir xil qolip.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a block of flats = ko'p qavatli turar joy
                binosi
  a fireplace = kamin
  a dressing table = kiyinish stoli
  a bookcase  = kitob javoni
  a wardrobe  = kiyim shkafi
  a CD player = CD pleyer
  a balcony   = balkon
  a carpet    = gilam
  a view      = manzara
  at last     = nihoyat

items.sentence: 1  It's on the seventh floor of a big ......................... near the city centre.  (RASM: baland ko'p qavatli bino)
items.uz: U shahar markazi yaqinidagi katta ko'p qavatli binoning yettinchi qavatida.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ BU — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (qiyshiq harflar
bilan yozilgan).

O'quvchi shundan vazifani tushunadi.

'a block of flats' = ko'p qavatli turar joy
binosi.

⚠ Britaniyada 'seventh floor' = yerdan
8-qavat (ground floor alohida sanaladi).

items.sentence: 2  It's got two bedrooms, a kitchen, a ......................... and a huge living-room.  (RASM: vanna)
items.uz: Unda ikkita yotoqxona, oshxona, hammom va katta mehmonxona bor.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ Rasmda VANNA, lekin javob 'BATHROOM'!

Sababi: gap XONALAR ro'yxati haqida —
'two bedroomS, a kitchen, a ......,
a living-room'. Hammasi XONA.

'bath' (vanna) — xona emas, buyum.

items.sentence: 3  ... a huge living-room with a ......................... in it.  (RASM: yonayotgan kamin)

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda yonayotgan olov va uning atrofidagi
g'ishtli ramka — bu KAMIN.

'a fireplace' = kamin ('fire' + 'place').

Word List 120-betda Unit 3 bo'limida bor.

items.sentence: 4  It's got a blue carpet on the floor and a large ......................... with a great view of the city.  (RASM: qizil pardalar)
items.uz: Polida ko'k gilam va shaharga ajoyib manzara ochiladigan katta deraza bor.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ Rasmda PARDALAR, lekin javob 'WINDOW'!

IKKI DALIL:
1) manzara ('view') DERAZADAN ochiladi,
   pardadan emas;
2) 'a LARGE' — BIRLIK, 'curtains' esa
   KO'PLIK ('a large curtains' XATO).

items.sentence: 5  My comfortable ......................... is right next to the ...  (RASM: karavot)

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda yostiqli karavot.

'right next to' = aynan yonida
('right' bu yerda kuchaytiruvchi).

items.sentence: 6  My comfortable bed is right next to the ......................... .  (RASM: kichik shkafcha ustidagi dumaloq oyna)

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda kichik shkafcha va uning ustida
DUMALOQ OYNA — bu kiyinish stoli.

'a dressing table' = kiyinish stoli
(oynasi bor stolcha).

Word List 120-betda Unit 3 bo'limida bor.

items.sentence: 7  There is also a small table in the room with a telephone and a ......................... on it.  (RASM: stol chirog'i)
items.uz: Xonada yana telefon va chiroq turgan kichik stol bor.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda abajurli stol chirog'i.

'a lamp' = chiroq (stol yoki poldagi).

⚠ 'a light' — umumiy yorug'lik;
'a lamp' — aniq buyum.

items.sentence: 8  I've got a big ........................., a large wardrobe, a TV and a CD player in my bedroom.  (RASM: kitobli javon)
items.uz: Yotoqxonamda katta kitob javoni, katta shkaf, televizor va CD pleyer bor.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rasmda rangli kitoblar terilgan javon.

'a bookcase' = kitob javoni
('book' + 'case').

⚠ 'a wardrobe' (kiyim shkafi) gapda
allaqachon bor — takrorlanmaydi.

items.sentence: 9  I've also got some ......................... on the walls.  (RASM: ramkali manzara rasmi)

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ KO'PLIKDA! 'SOME' dan keyin sanaladigan ot
KO'PLIKDA bo'ladi.

  'some PICTURES'  ✓
  'some PICTURE'   ✗

'on the walls' ham ko'plik — bir nechta rasm.

items.sentence: 10  My bedroom has got a balcony, too. There are some ......................... on it.  (RASM: guldondagi o'simlik)
items.uz: Yotoqxonamning balkoni ham bor. Unda gullar turibdi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ KO'PLIKDA! 'THERE ARE some ...' —
ko'plik.

  'There ARE some PLANTS'  ✓
  'There IS some plant'    ✗

'a plant' = o'simlik, guldondagi gul.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ RASM ↔ JAVOB MOS KELMAYDIGAN IKKI BAND
groups.explanationUz: Kitob rasmga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas, GAP MA'NOSIGA qarab javob talab qiladi.
